about_the_game:
Long ago, ancient civilizations left behind the ruins of once great cities. In this dark world, filled with echoes of the suffering of the last war, you are one of the few people capable of fighting evil.

An incredible journey awaits you into a fairytale world filled with enormous trees, cities and villages, and monsters called shadows that devour life.

There are dialogues and battles, confidence against doubt, and the danger of annihilation intertwined with moral dilemmas.

Oh, life! If only there were a simple path to choose! But there isn't, it must be complex, mustn't it, hero? The world is full of puzzles, but only if you can defeat the emptiness within, those who are neither water nor fire!

They are poisoned by the dark forces with the venom of vices, and otherwise, are they like empty vessels? Are they not full of goodness or soul?

The dreams of ordinary people, like those from ancient legends, were mercilessly erased by the evil dark king. After seeing him, after losing the remnants of your soul, it's probably difficult to remain yourself, isn't it?

Perhaps you can learn how to uncover the secret and defeat evil? Do you believe in yourself? Are you ready to accept the fight, to know fear and go through pain?

Just press the button and receive a letter. When the game is released, you will feel for yourself how good and evil look in the reflections of mirrors...

You can expect at least 8 hours of gameplay. A deep storyline and various mechanics, many unique locations and quests with moral choices. Engaging dialogues with characters and battles with powerful enemies. Puzzles and creation, a dark atmosphere and destruction, pleasant graphics and an interactive world.

Join this exciting journey where your fate depends on your decisions, and every step brings you closer to unraveling the greatest mystery – the true nature of light and darkness. Will you be able to find a balance between these forces and become the one who changes the world?

content_descriptors.notes:
Violence; Throughout the game, the player will kill enemy heroes, monsters, and possibly animals. At the scene of the murder, there will be corpses (rag doll) and a black liquid similar to blood until they disappear after a while. Whether to display this or not can be specified in the settings.
Nudity: a woman in a swimsuit or a man with a naked torso is the most you can see in this game.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050Ti 4GB or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 32 GB available space

short_description: In a World split by the confrontation between Light and Darkness, where Ancient Civilizations left behind Ruins of once great cities. You are a warrior of Light! The last ray of hope! The Future of this Magical World depends on you!
